records.title: Policy Regret for Embedding Model Routing: Contextual Bandits with Low-Rank Experts
records.reason: 動的なモデル選択をbandit feedback下で学習し、各queryにつき1モデルだけを呼び出すため、query routingと呼出し費用を伴うservingへの方法論的関連性がある。一方、対象は推薦・検索のembedding model群であり、評価も埋め込みモデルによる推薦品質の選択が中心で、LLM生成推論のrouting、生成品質と費用の実測、LLM serving性能は扱っていない。周辺知見としての関連性はあるが、LLM推論効率への直接適用は本文から実証されず、対象領域への近さをborderlineとする。
records.body_check: arXiv一次全文v2（https://arxiv.org/html/2606.14929v2）を確認。§2.1–2.3は、adversarial queryを文脈とし、低rank埋め込みモデルのうち1つだけを各roundで呼び、選択モデルの推薦とnoisy rewardのみを見る設定を定義。§3は各モデルの期待rewardをqueryの低rank二次形式で近似するlog-quadratic routing policyを導き、厳密なpolicy regretではなくsoftmaxの非凸性を扱うlinearized policy regretを評価対象とする。§4–5 Algorithm 1とTheorems 3–5は、nuclear-norm制約、hypentropy正則化、REINFORCE型勾配推定を組み合わせるHypentropy Policy Gradient (HPG) を提案し、未知rank sにもparameter-freeに適応、Otilde(s sqrt(MT)) linearized policy regretとO(d_q^2 M) round当たり計算量を示す。§3.1/Table 2はAmazon ESCIの97,345 query、8 embedding models、Contriever 768次元query/item表現で各policy classの最適routingをoffline比較し、全query平均gapをconstant 0.035、log-linear 0.030、log-quadratic 0.011（log-linearから63.5%改善）と報告する。これはHPGオンライン学習の実行評価ではなく、policy classの適合性確認である。§1のAmazon Berkeley Objects例は500商品からGemini-2.5-proでfiltering・soft-constraint採点した図示例で、主要なオンラインrouting評価ではない。§6はlinearized surrogate保証を厳密なpolicy regretへ移す問題と下界の必要性が未解決と明記。したがって推薦embedding routingとしての関連と、LLM推論効率への未実証な距離を併記する。

records.title: Holding the FP8 Quality Ceiling at 8-Bit Weights and Activations: INT8 and GGUF Post-Training Quantization of Ideogram 4.0 for Consumer GPUs
records.reason: The primary text studies post-training quantization of Ideogram 4.0, a text-to-image flow-matching diffusion transformer, for image-generation quality, fidelity, memory, and latency on RTX 3090 GPUs. This is diffusion image-generation model compression rather than LLM inference, serving, or inference-time compression, so it falls outside this survey's scope despite being linked from an LLM INT8 paper.
records.body_check: Read the arXiv v2 full text, especially §§1, 3-5, 6-8. §1 identifies Ideogram 4.0 as a 9.3B flow-matching DiT with separate conditional/unconditional branches and a Qwen3-VL text encoder; §3 quantizes the two DiT branches while leaving the text encoder and VAE at published precision. §§4-5 evaluate image quality, OCR, fidelity to FP8 outputs, model size, and seconds per image on RTX 3090s: INT8 W8A8 gives the closest FP8 fidelity (LPIPS 0.243) but takes about 184 s/image without a fused INT8 GEMM, while GGUF Q4_K is 10.44 GB and 203.3 s/image. §§6-7 discuss prompt-format dependence and limitations, and §8 provides gated, non-commercial quantized weight links. The paper's subject is image-generation DiT quantization; it does not propose an LLM inference/serving optimization.

records.title: ReasonAlloc: Hierarchical Decoding-Time KV Cache Budget Allocation for Reasoning Models
records.reason: ReasonAlloc is a training-free inference-time method that compresses reasoning-model KV caches by assigning nonuniform budgets across layers and dynamically across heads during autoregressive decoding. This directly targets serving memory and throughput constraints for long reasoning generations.
records.body_check: Read the primary arXiv HTML v1 body, including Sections 1, 3-8 and Appendices C, D, E, H, and I. Sections 4-5 describe measured layer/head KV-demand heterogeneity, an offline layer calibration ('Reasoning Wave'), and online head routing refreshed every 128 generated tokens; shared power smoothing and min/max clipping prevent starvation while preserving the global token budget. Section 6 evaluates MATH-500 and AIME 2024 with R1-Llama-8B, R1-Qwen-14B, and AceReason-14B against FullKV, SnapKV, uniform R-KV, and Pyramid-RKV. For R1-Llama-8B, ReasonAlloc reports 82.50% vs. 76.48% for R-KV on MATH-500 at budget 512, and 20.00% vs. 10.42% on AIME 2024 at budget 256. Section 7 / Appendix H report RTX 4090 throughput; at 16K generation and budget 1024, ReasonAlloc reaches 218.82 tokens/s (5.52x FullKV) and matches the R-KV throughput range, so these speedups primarily reflect bounded-cache batching over FullKV rather than a throughput gain over compressed baselines. Appendix C says task-dependent general models may need its fully dynamic layer-allocation fallback. Appendix I notes accuracy experiments used 8x H20, a single decoding seed, and parameters manually probed on one AIME prompt. The primary body supports inference/KV-cache relevance; current-main duplicate resolution remains for the repository precheck.
